_comment: Committed regression baseline for the FALSE-POSITIVE-FIRST gate (tests/test_eval_regression.py), measured with the PRODUCTION scorer+cutoff over cached/text/negative cases. 'fp' is a hard ceiling: any run with more false positives fails the test. 'recall' is advisory: a drop only warns, because becoming more conservative is acceptable. Re-baseline (lower fp and/or raise recall) after a deliberate scorer/cutoff change: re-run eval, then update these numbers.
